* Build and maintain candidate pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.
* Screen candidates based on skills, experience, communication, availability, compensation expectations, and overall suitability for the position.
* Recruit across a mix of **technical and non-technical positions**, depending on business requirements.

* Non-technical hiring may include positions across **Operations, Finance/Accounting, Human Resources, Project Management, Administration, and other business functions**.

* Maintain accurate candidate and recruitment information in the **Applicant Tracking System (ATS)**.
* Follow up with hiring managers for interview feedback and facilitate timely hiring decisions.
* Support offer discussions, documentation, background-check coordination, and onboarding activities.
* Build strong relationships with candidates and provide a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Track recruiting activity and provide regular updates on open positions, candidate pipelines, interviews, offers, and closures.
* Stay informed about recruitment trends, talent availability, sourcing practices, and relevant technology hiring trends.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology**, or a related field preferred.
* **1–3 years of hands-on recruitment experience**.
* Experience managing the **full recruitment lifecycle**.
* Strong sourcing experience using **LinkedIn, Indeed, Boolean searches, job boards, and other recruiting platforms**.
* Experience conducting candidate screening and qualification calls.
* Familiarity with **ATS and recruitment tracking systems**.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple open positions and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-up skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience recruiting across multiple functions, including **IT/Technology, Operations, Finance/Accounting, HR, Administration, and Project Management**.
* Experience working with **U.S.-based clients**.
* Experience working in a fast-paced **staffing, consulting, or corporate recruitment environment**.
* Knowledge of recruitment metrics and reporting.

**Key Competencies**

* Technical and non-technical candidate sourcing
* Candidate screening and qualification
* Boolean search
* Candidate pipeline management
* Stakeholder and hiring-manager management
* Interview coordination
* Negotiation and communication
* ATS management
* Candidate relationship management
* Time management and prioritization

**Success in This Role:** A successful Technical Recruiter will be able to **quickly understand both technical and non-technical hiring requirements, identify qualified candidates efficiently, maintain strong communication with hiring managers and candidates, and consistently move positions toward closure while maintaining recruitment quality and a positive candidate experience**.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!  
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

**Position Title:** Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Company:** VIRA Insight

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Reports to:** Director of HR & GCC

**Department:** Strategic Support

Position Summary

The Talent Acquisition Specialist is a hands-on, hybrid role combining full-cycle talent acquisition with office management, HR support, process ownership, and culture ambassadorship. The role owns recruitment execution from intake through offer delivery while helping create an organized, engaging, and employee-focused workplace.

This position works closely with hiring managers, employees, HR partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across the India and USA offices. The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, collaborative, service-oriented, and comfortable balancing recruitment priorities with day-to-day office and employee-support needs in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  

* Own full-cycle recruitment execution, including hiring intake, job posting, active sourcing, candidate screening, interview coordination and participation, selection support, reference or background-check coordination, and offer delivery.
* Partner with hiring managers to clarify role requirements, candidate profiles, interview processes, priorities, and hiring timelines.
* Proactively source qualified and diverse talent through job boards, social media, professional networks, employee referrals, colleges, technical institutions, community partnerships, and other creative channels.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs while strengthening the Company’s employer brand.
* Deliver a responsive, transparent, and engaging candidate experience from initial outreach through preboarding and onboarding.
* Maintain accurate candidate, requisition, interview, offer, and hiring records in the applicant tracking system and related trackers.
* Own recruitment process discipline by documenting workflows, monitoring service levels, identifying gaps, and recommending practical improvements.
* Track recruitment activity and outcomes, prepare timely reports, and use data to improve sourcing, conversion, candidate experience, and hiring efficiency.
* Coordinate with external recruitment agencies, background-verification providers, job boards, and other vendors as needed.
* Support new-hire onboarding, orientation, documentation, induction schedules, and workplace integration to ensure a smooth joining experience.
* Provide day-to-day HR administrative support, including employee documentation, HRIS updates, letters, records, policy communication, and coordination of employee queries.
* Support office management activities, including workplace readiness, supplies, facilities coordination, vendor follow-up, meeting logistics, visitor support, and resolution of routine office issues.
* Serve as a culture ambassador by promoting the Company’s Core Values, encouraging employee participation, and supporting recognition, engagement, wellness, celebration, and team-building initiatives.
* Act as an approachable point of contact for employees, respond promptly to routine questions, and connect employees with the appropriate HR or business resource when escalation is needed.
* Coordinate communication and collaboration between the India and USA offices on hiring, onboarding, workplace activities, and employee-experience initiatives.
* Build positive working relationships across teams, contribute as a dependable team player, and proactively step in to support shared priorities.
* Handle confidential employee and candidate information with sound judgment, professionalism, and discretion.
* Support HR Partner, Talent Acquisition, office, and culture-related projects and perform other related duties as assigned.

**Supervisory responsibility:** This is an individual-contributor position and does not have direct reports.

Position Requirements

  

* Hands-on knowledge of full-cycle recruiting, active sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate assessment, and offer coordination.
* Proactive and resourceful approach, with the ability to anticipate needs, take ownership, and follow through with limited supervision.
* Strong process orientation and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accurate records and improve workflows.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Employee-focused and approachable, with a genuine interest in engagement, culture, and workplace experience.
* Collaborative team player who builds trust and works effectively across functions, levels, and geographies.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to balance recruiting, HR support, office operations, and employee activities.
* Ability to manage changing priorities, meet deadlines, and resolve routine issues in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of applicant tracking systems, HRIS platforms, sourcing tools, and recruitment technology, Workday experience is a Plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related productivity tools.
* Professional judgment, discretion, and commitment to confidentiality.

Required Education and Experience

  

* Masters/Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred, but not required.
* Three or more years of experience in talent acquisition for technical and non-technical hirings, with demonstrated ownership of full-cycle hiring activities.
* Experience with active sourcing, interviewing, candidate management, offer coordination, and applicant tracking systems.
* Experience supporting HR administration, onboarding, employee engagement, office coordination, or workplace operations is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with cross-functional or international stakeholders, particularly across India and the USA, is a plus.

Other Job Requirements

  

* Ability to travel up to 10% of the time or as required.
* Available to work from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST.
* Frequently required to sit, stand, walk, talk, and hear.
* Valid Indian Passport
* Ability to operate a computer keyboard and read a variety of materials.
* Ability to sit for extended periods.
* Ability to carry 5–10 lbs. (computer, etc.).

General Statement

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or physical requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Statement of Employment

All employees of VIRA Insight are expected to:

* Act as an ambassador of and in accordance with the company’s Core Values.
* Adhere to the company’s Principles of Business and Conduct.
* Demonstrate good judgment and respect the confidentiality of company and personnel information.
* Deal professionally and courteously with all internal and external contacts.
* Seek guidance and direction as necessary in the performance of duties.

Job Description: IT Recruiter

**Job Title:** IT Recruiter / Junior IT Recruiter  
**Experience:** 3 Months – 1 Year  
**Job Type:** Full-Time (Work from Office) - Mandatory  
**Department:** Human Resources / Talent Acquisition  
**Location:** Bangalore (Kasthuri Nagar)

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic IT Recruiter with 3 months to 1 year of experience in technical recruitment. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of IT roles, good communication skills, and the ability to source, screen, and coordinate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

Roles and Responsibilities

* Source candidates through job portals such as Naukri, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic screening to assess candidates’ skills, experience, and communication abilities.
* Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates for various IT positions.
* Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview feedback and selection status.
* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future requirements.
* Ensure timely communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Work closely with the recruitment team to achieve hiring targets.

Required Skills

* 3 months to 1 year of experience in IT recruitment or talent acquisition.
* Basic knowledge of IT technologies, technical roles, and industry terminology.
* Familiarity with job portals such as Naukri and LinkedIn.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong sourcing, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to multitask and work in a target-driven environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new recruitment strategies.

Educational Qualification

* Any graduate degree (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
* A background or certification in Human Resources is an added advantage.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to learn and grow in IT recruitment.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment.
* Career growth opportunities in Talent Acquisition.
* Exposure to different IT technologies and recruitment processes.

**Interested candidates can share their updated resumes**

Ramarani G

description:
**Req ID:** 391949
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Delivery Advisor to join our team in Bengaluru, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Role Summary:** Experienced individual contributor responsible for IT Asset Management of enterprise network assets, including hardware lifecycle governance, Cisco/Palo Alto licensing, CMDB/CI accuracy, monthly billing validation and client reporting.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Manage IT Asset Management activities for in-scope network assets and act as an experienced point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.
* Oversee network asset lifecycle activities including onboarding, inventory, deployment, movement, refresh, return and retirement/disposal in coordination with operational teams.
* Maintain accurate asset and Configuration Item (CI) records in the agreed ITAM/CMDB platform, including ownership, location, status, relationships and lifecycle data.
* Reconcile asset records across CMDB/AMDB, discovery/network-management sources, procurement and other agreed data sources; investigate and coordinate resolution of exceptions.
* Manage software, subscription and support licensing for Cisco, Palo Alto and other agreed network vendors, including entitlement, consumption, renewal and compliance tracking.
* Maintain visibility of warranty, maintenance, end-of-life and end-of-support positions and coordinate actions with Network, Procurement and vendor teams.
* Validate monthly asset billing, including billable populations, additions/removals, service status and billing variances.
* Produce operational and governance reporting covering inventory, CMDB accuracy, licensing/compliance risks, renewals, billing and outstanding actions.
* Support hardware/software audits and maintain required asset, entitlement and compliance evidence.
* Define and improve ITAM processes, controls, SOPs and data-quality measures; identify automation, optimization and cost-avoidance opportunities.
* Partner with Network Operations, Procurement, Finance, Service Management, Configuration Management and vendors to ensure end-to-end governance.
* Support transition and service-takeover activities, including knowledge transfer, validation of asset data and operational readiness.

**Requirements:**  

* 8+ years of experience in IT Asset Management, Hardware Asset Management, Software Asset Management, Configuration Management or related infrastructure service management roles.
* Based in India and willing to work aligned to U.S. business hours to support client operations and stakeholder collaboration.
* Strong understanding of hardware lifecycle management and CMDB/CI governance in enterprise environments.
* Experience managing network infrastructure assets such as routers, switches, firewalls, wireless/network appliances and associated support records.
* Working knowledge of Cisco and Palo Alto software/subscription licensing, entitlements, renewals and compliance concepts.
* Experience with asset reconciliation, data-quality/exception management and monthly asset-based billing or chargeback validation.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, including Excel and large asset/CMDB/licensing datasets.
* Strong customer-facing communication, governance and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferences:**  

* Experience with ServiceNow ITAM/HAM, CMDB and/or SAM Pro; Flexera, Snow or similar platforms is advantageous.
* Cisco Smart Licensing/Smart Account and Palo Alto subscription/support licensing exposure preferred.
* ITIL and ITAM certifications such as CITAM, CHAMP, CSAM or equivalent preferred.

Experience in managed services environments and reporting tools such as Power BI/Tableau is advantageous.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.

While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

title: AI/ML Manager
description:
**Job Description: AI/ML Manager – Enterprise AI Implementation**

**Location:** Malaysia  
**Candidate Sourcing:** India  
**Experience:** 8–15+ years overall experience, including significant experience leading AI/ML initiatives  
**Role Level:** Senior Manager / AI Transformation Manager / Head of AI Implementation (designation based on experience)

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **AI/ML Manager with proven experience in enterprise-level Artificial Intelligence implementation** to lead the strategy, planning, development, deployment, and scaling of AI-driven solutions across business functions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of AI/ML technical knowledge, enterprise technology leadership, stakeholder management, and program delivery experience. This role requires a professional who has successfully taken AI initiatives beyond proof of concept (PoC) and pilots into production environments, delivering measurable business value, operational efficiency, and scalable enterprise capabilities.

The candidate will work closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, IT teams, data engineering teams, and external technology partners to identify AI opportunities, establish implementation roadmaps, and drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI solutions.

Candidates must have demonstrable experience managing large-scale AI implementations in complex business or enterprise environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop and execute enterprise AI strategies aligned with organizational business objectives.
* Identify high-impact opportunities for AI/ML adoption across business functions, operations, products, and customer-facing applications.
* Define AI implementation roadmaps, investment priorities, business cases, and delivery milestones.
* Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, technical feasibility, scalability, risk, and expected return on investment.
* Lead the transition from AI experimentation and proof of concept to production-grade enterprise implementations.
* Establish standards, frameworks, and best practices for enterprise AI adoption.

**2. Enterprise AI Implementation & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of AI/ML solutions across multiple business units or enterprise functions.
* Oversee AI programs from requirements gathering and solution architecture through development, integration, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage large-scale AI implementation projects involving multiple teams, technology platforms, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Ensure AI solutions integrate effectively with existing enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and business workflows.
* Drive the deployment of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable AI systems.
* Track implementation progress, resolve delivery challenges, manage dependencies, and ensure successful project outcomes.
* Establish clear success metrics and measure the business impact of deployed AI solutions.

**3. Generative AI & Enterprise LLM Adoption**

* Lead the evaluation and implementation of Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions for enterprise use cases.
* Drive the adoption of enterprise AI applications such as intelligent assistants, knowledge management systems, document intelligence, conversational AI, workflow automation, and decision-support systems.
* Oversee initiatives involving Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enterprise search, AI agents, model orchestration, and integration with internal knowledge repositories, where relevant.
* Evaluate commercial AI platforms, foundation models, and open-source technologies based on business needs, security, cost, performance, and scalability.
* Define approaches for responsible LLM deployment, model evaluation, output quality, and risk management.
* Establish appropriate controls for sensitive enterprise data, access permissions, hallucination risks, and human oversight.

**4. AI/ML Program & Team Management**

* Lead and manage cross-functional teams comprising AI/ML engineers, data scientists, data engineers, software developers, architects, and business analysts.
* Define project scope, resource plans, budgets, timelines, deliverables, and governance structures.
* Build and mentor high-performing AI teams and develop internal capabilities for sustainable AI adoption.
* Manage external implementation partners, consultants, and technology vendors where applicable.
* Establish delivery standards, review mechanisms, performance indicators, and escalation processes.
* Communicate program progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior management and executive stakeholders.

**5. Enterprise Architecture & Technology Governance**

* Work with enterprise architects, IT leaders, and data leaders to define scalable AI solution architectures.
* Guide decisions regarding cloud-based AI platforms, data infrastructure, model deployment, enterprise integration, and technology selection.
* Ensure AI solutions align with enterprise architecture, application security, infrastructure, and data management standards.
* Promote appropriate MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
* Establish governance processes for model validation, performance monitoring, versioning, and production support.

**6. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Establish governance frameworks for enterprise AI implementation and adoption.
* Ensure AI solutions adhere to applicable data privacy, information security, regulatory, and organizational policies.
* Address risks related to data leakage, model bias, explainability, reliability, intellectual property, and unauthorized AI usage.
* Work with security, compliance, legal, and risk teams to define appropriate controls and approval processes.
* Promote responsible, transparent, and auditable AI practices across the organization.

**7. Business Value & Transformation**

* Partner with business leaders to redesign processes and identify opportunities for AI-led transformation.
* Quantify business benefits, including productivity improvements, cost optimization, faster decision-making, and enhanced customer experience.
* Develop business cases and establish KPIs to measure AI adoption, operational impact, and return on investment.
* Drive change management, user adoption, training, and organizational readiness for AI-enabled workflows.
* Present implementation outcomes, strategic recommendations, and progress reports to executive leadership.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Approximately **8–15+ years of overall technology, data, digital transformation, or AI-related experience**, with the level adjusted to the complexity of prior enterprise implementations.
* Significant experience managing or leading enterprise AI/ML implementation programs.
* Demonstrated success taking AI initiatives from business requirements and PoCs into production deployment and scaled adoption.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams and complex technology delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, enterprise data platforms, cloud technologies, and modern AI architectures.
* Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders, IT leadership, and executive management.
* Proven ability to connect technology investments with measurable business outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills & Competencies**

* Enterprise AI implementation and transformation.
* AI/ML program and project management.
* AI strategy, use-case prioritization, and roadmap development.
* Production deployment and scaling of AI solutions.
* Stakeholder and executive management.
* Enterprise solution architecture and systems integration.
* Team leadership, resource planning, and delivery governance.
* Business case development, KPI tracking, and ROI measurement.
* AI risk management, governance, privacy, and security awareness.

**Preferred Technical Exposure**

Candidates should have practical implementation or leadership exposure to several of the following:

* Enterprise Generative AI and LLM platforms.
* RAG-based applications, enterprise search, and AI assistants.
* Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and predictive analytics.
* Microsoft Azure AI, AWS AI services, or Google Cloud AI.
* Enterprise data platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, and data engineering.
* MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, and deployment automation.
* AI application integration with ERP, CRM, enterprise knowledge systems, and business applications.
* AI agents, workflow automation, and intelligent process automation.
* Commercial AI platforms and open-source AI ecosystems.

**Key Success Criteria**

The successful candidate will demonstrate a track record of:

* Delivering at least one or more significant AI implementations in a complex enterprise environment.
* Moving AI solutions from experimentation to production and sustained business use.
* Managing multiple stakeholders, teams, and technology dependencies.
* Establishing effective AI governance, security, and operational controls.
* Demonstrating measurable business value from AI investments.
* Driving adoption of AI solutions across teams, departments, or business units.

**Location & Relocation**

**Work Location:** Malaysia  
**Target Candidate Pool:** Experienced professionals currently based in India and willing to relocate to Malaysia.

Candidates must be open to international relocation and working with multicultural, geographically distributed teams. Relocation arrangements and work authorization will be discussed during the recruitment process.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a strategic yet execution-oriented technology leader who understands both the business and technical dimensions of enterprise AI.

The ideal candidate is not limited to AI research, model development, or proof-of-concept experimentation. They should have direct ownership or substantial leadership responsibility for **implementing, integrating, deploying, governing, and scaling AI solutions in a real enterprise environment**.

Experience in enterprise digital transformation, consulting-led AI implementations, large technology programs, or AI platform adoption will be highly valued.

**Application Requirements**

Interested candidates should provide:

* Updated CV highlighting enterprise AI implementations.
* Total years of experience and relevant AI leadership experience.
* Examples of AI programs delivered, including business problem, solution, implementation scale, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience with production deployment, enterprise integration, and AI governance.
* Team size, budget, and program ownership, where applicable.
* Current location, notice period, and compensation expectations.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.

Cloud, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity Managed Services Operations | Experience: 14+ Years
  
At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
Role Purpose
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. The CDM works with the Client Architect to operationalize transformation roadmaps, automation and AIOps improvements without compromising service stability.
  
  
Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Service Operations Delivery Control
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change Risk Management
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.
* Govern change execution, operational risks, audit actions, security/compliance obligations and continuity or disaster-recovery readiness.

Resource, Vendor Asset Management
  

* Manage workforce demand, staffing, shifts, skills, utilization, onboarding/offboarding, knowledge transfer and succession coverage.
* Coordinate tower leads, operations managers, partners and vendors; establish clear ownership and consequence-based closure of commitments.
* Oversee operational hardware/software assets, licenses and vendor dependencies within the service scope.

Cost Efficiency Financial Operations
  

* Control delivery costs in line with the account operating plan and provide accurate operational inputs for revenue, cost, margin and forecast reviews.
* Drive productivity, pyramid optimization, capacity alignment, leakage prevention and efficient ramp-up/ramp-down of resources.
* Track operational benefits from automation, continuous improvement and cost-efficiency initiatives; escalate forecast or cost gaps with corrective actions.

Client Operations Governance
  

* Serve as the primary contact for client operations leadership and lead service reviews, operational governance and action closure.
* Maintain clear and timely communication on performance, risks, incidents, recovery plans and improvement priorities.
* Support the CDE with MBR, QBR inputs, client escalations, renewals and delivery-led opportunities while keeping ownership centered on operational execution.

Automation, AIOps Continual Improvement
  

* Identify repetitive work, ticket drivers and process gaps suitable for automation, AIOps and intelligent service management.
* Partner with the Principal Client Architect and practices to implement approved improvements and embed them into standard operations.
* Measure realized outcomes such as ticket reduction, faster restoration, reduced manual effort, improved reliability and better user experience.

People Leadership
  

* Coach delivery and operations leaders, set clear expectations and build a culture of accountability, ITIL discipline, collaboration and customer focus.
* Develop operational capability, certifications, cross-skilling, engagement and retention across geographically distributed teams.

Required Experience Qualifications
  

* 14+ years in IT services or managed services, including substantial responsibility for enterprise infrastructure, cloud or cybersecurity operations.
* Proven leadership of day-to-day service delivery across complex, global and multi-tower accounts with measurable SLA/KPI and customer outcomes.

WSP is hiring an Extensive experience in the design, manufacture and test of HV cables for use in HVAC and Desirable - HVDC projects both onshore and offshore; including HV cable system design and ratings (CYMCAP).

  

* Assisting the leadership technically for the successful delivery of multi discipline projects.
* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with the contract to the satisfaction of the client, ensuring that relevant Health and Safety risks are identified, made known to the project team and properly managed.
* Actively developing external and internal client relationships.
* Providing technical management coordination of any subcontractors and resources remote from the core project team.
* Ensuring that technical risks are identified and mitigated.
* Ensuring that all statutory and regulatory requirements are met.
* Actively taking part in Industry working groups such as CIGRE, IEEE.
* Actively developing external and internal relationships

  

* Education - Bachelors Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical discipline, preferably Electrical or Power engineering with five to ten years of experience.
* Extensive experience in the design, manufacture and test of HV cables for use in HVAC and
* Desirable - HVDC projects both onshore and offshore; including HV cable system design and ratings (CYMCAP)
* An understanding of IEC cable standards and CIGRE technical policies, its suite of technical specifications and supporting documentation, and the capability to fulfil a role as a cable expert.
* Preparation, review and validation of Technical Proposal from Transmission & Distribution projects.
* Preparation of technical documents/calculations using Cable Modelling Software CYMCAP.
* System designing experience - Selection of Bonding System, Earth Continuity Cable & Co-Axial Cable, Short circuit calculations, Cable Bonding layout.
* Experience of witnessing 3rd party cable activities such as test, installation, transport etc.
* Attained or working towards Chartered Engineer status.

title: Senior, Tax Services-CBC-USBT-Hyderabad
description:
US Business Tax – Tax Senior – Hyderabad

  
  

Do you have a passion to work for U.S.-based clients of Deloitte Tax to provide tax compliance services? Are you ready to take the next step in your career by focusing on providing US corporate, partnership, and trust tax return compliance? Are you ready to fulfill your potential and want to have a significant impact to global initiatives? If the answer to all of the above is "Yes," come join us!

  
  

Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines and regions have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support practice U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option. In recent years, member firms, such as Australia, Belgium, Bermuda, Canada, the Cayman Islands, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, etc. have obtained support in their tax related practice through the Deloitte Tax in India.

  
  

Work You’ll Do

  
  

You would be working with our Bermuda, Cayman Islands, and Virgin Islands based US Business Tax team members (i.e. 30+ US tax professionals based permanently in the Caribbean and Bermuda region) and will enjoy the unique opportunity to broaden your network across the firm as a whole. This dynamic group provides exposure to an unrivalled client portfolio of multinational companies and a variety of tax work including compliance and consulting projects.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

✓ Perform detail-review of tax workpapers, allocations, and US federal, state, and local partnership, and trust tax returns and computations using standard procedures, across a range of financial services clients.

  
  

✓ Working with an integrated partner/manager/assistant manager team on sizeable US tax compliance engagements for multinational clients, including maintaining responsibility for preparation of materials and research for complex tax compliance and consulting projects related to tax planning opportunities, including those prepared by junior team members.

  
  

✓ Requesting and obtaining tax information from clients and third parties.

  
  

✓ Communicating with clients to explain positions taken on tax returns, filing requirements, payment instructions, etc.

  
  

✓ Training, mentoring, and supervising new and experienced-level staff.

  
  

The Team

  
  

Deloitte India (Offices of the Caribbean and Bermuda Countries [CBC]) US Tax Compliance Group based in Hyderabad specializes in three core areas: US partnership federal, state, and local tax return preparation, electronic filing of the returns and research and writing tax technical memorandums on a range of topics related to US partnership taxation in an international context. On taking up a position with the US team, you will have the opportunity to focus on at least two of these core specialties.

  
  

The Caribbean and Bermuda Countries member firm tax professionals who work in the US business tax practice are based in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, and the Virgin Islands. This team of 30+ permanent professionals ranges in grades from Partner to new tax consultant who are trained as US Certified Public Accountants, IRS Enrolled Agents, bar-admitted lawyers and/or master’s degree graduates, and serves a client base consisting of a range of financial services industry clients, including hedge funds, private equity funds, fund-of-funds, and insurance companies.

  
  

Required Qualifications

  
  

✓ Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or other business-related field

  
  

✓ 4+ years of experience in US partnership tax compliance, including knowledge of, and experience using, US income tax software and standard US tax research tools

  
  

✓ Enrolled Agent (EA) certification (or in the process of pursuing)

  
  

✓ Strong accounting knowledge and interest in US tax, including extensive US partnership experience related to hedge funds.

  
  

✓ Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, including strong written and verbal communication

  
  

✓ Experience with managing projects, including scheduling, budgeting, client correspondence, billing, team development, and mentoring

  
  

✓ High level of attention to detail, organizational skills, and analytical problem-solving abilities

  
  

✓ Can work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

  
  

✓ Knowledge of Microsoft Office products — in particular, Excel, Word, and Sharepoint

  
  

Work Location

  
  

Hyderabad

  
  

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

#### **An overview of this role**

As Senior Manager, Total Rewards Operations, India, you'll lead a small team supporting GitLab's global benefits and compensation operations. You'll translate global program priorities into dependable execution, strengthen operational controls, and make processes easier to run and support across regions and time zones. You'll set clear priorities and quality standards while coaching your team to deliver accurate work. You'll support global programs in partnership with their functional owners, rather than set enterprise-wide compensation or benefits strategy.

**What You’ll Do**

* Oversee, coach, and develop the day-to-day responsibilities for the local Benefits Analyst and Senior Total Rewards Operations Analyst, establishing clear ownership, goals, feedback practices, and coverage plans.
* Prioritize global benefits support and compensation operations work, balancing recurring cycles, service requests, audits, and time-sensitive projects.
* Oversee compensation operations support, including market-data workflows, compensation-cycle preparation, system transactions, equity grant data checks, and audit evidence.
* Establish quality controls, review points, escalation paths, and records practices that protect sensitive compensation and benefits information and maintain appropriate access and confidentiality.
* Monitor deadlines, dependencies, service trends, and risks, surfacing issues early and carrying practical process improvements through to adoption.
* Partner with global program owners to coordinate execution across geographies, communicate local considerations, and support consistent team member experiences through clear written updates, decision records, and reusable documentation.
* Work with People Technology and system stakeholders to clarify requirements, test process and system changes, and improve data quality and workflow efficiency, using artificial intelligence tools responsibly where appropriate.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience in Total Rewards, benefits, compensation operations, or a closely related People function in a global organization, with working knowledge of benefits administration and/or compensation processes and their dependencies.
* Demonstrated people-management ability, including setting priorities, coaching team members, and developing operational capability.
* A record of delivering accurate work across multiple deadlines, stakeholders, and time zones, supported by practical controls, root-cause analysis, and process improvements.
* Clear written communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain processes and escalate risks.
* Sound judgment with confidential data and sensitive team member matters.
* Ability to use spreadsheets, human resources systems, and collaboration tools to manage workflows and validate data.
* Fluency in artificial intelligence tools and the ability to use them responsibly to improve Total Rewards work and team processes.
* Helpful, but not required: experience supporting a distributed, multi-country workforce or working with benefits vendors, brokers, salary surveys, equity grant operations, or compensation review cycles.

The Senior Total Rewards Operations Manager supports global total rewards programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. The team's tools include Workday, Google Workspace, Slack, and Claude. The role emphasizes accurate administration, team-member support, and practical process improvements, with opportunities to build deeper total rewards expertise.

Our system spans a full-stack web application, a rich and deliberately complex Azure cloud environment, and on-premises Linux lab infrastructure that talks directly to FPGA hardware. The person who thrives here will be someone who gets energized by that kind of variety, not overwhelmed by it.
  
Just as importantly, we are looking for someone who communicates well, enjoys working closely with developers and customers, and takes real pride in the quality and reliability of what they build and maintain. Technical depth matters, but so does being someone the team genuinely enjoys working with.
  
The Environment You Will Be Working In
  
The Application
  
We build and operate a full-stack web application with a Node.js server, TypeScript services, and a React.js client. The application connects to on-premises Linux lab environments where a Python-based layer orchestrates and controls FPGA hardware. The cloud and the physical lab need to talk to each other reliably, securely, and continuously.
  
The Internal Azure Subscription
  
This environment is mature, fully operational, and genuinely complex. Containerized workloads run on Kubernetes. We use the right database for the right job: relational databases for structured data, a document store for flexibility, in-memory caching for performance, distributed file storage for shared access, and large-scale telemetry and analytics through Azure Data Explorer. Identity and access management spans SSO, Active Directory, Kerberos, and Microsoft Entra ID, because our permission model is real-world complex, not textbook simple. We also run an internal HPC-grade job scheduling system that manages compute resource allocation and permissions across lab infrastructure.
  
The External Azure Subscription
  
This subscription is starting now and will serve customers outside our organization. Security, network architecture, compliance, and performance are the foundation here, not afterthoughts. You will be building this alongside our network and cybersecurity teams with genuine ownership of getting it right.
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
CI/CD and Developer Support
  
Design, maintain, and continuously improve pipelines covering the full delivery lifecycle for our Node.js, TypeScript, and React codebase. When something breaks in a pipeline or a release goes sideways, the development team will come to you, and you will be the person who unblocks them calmly and effectively. Beyond day-to-day support, you will raise the quality bar by embedding good practices into the workflow: automated testing, regression coverage, reproducible builds, and documentation that people actually use.
  
Automation and AI-Driven Operations
  
We want a platform that monitors itself, detects problems, and recovers on its own wherever possible. When it cannot, it should tell us clearly and give us what we need to act fast. We want you to use AI tools actively and creatively to get there, whether that means intelligent alerting, automated remediation, generated runbooks, or things we have not thought of yet. Every repeated manual task is a candidate for automation.
  
Platform and Infrastructure Engineering
  
Own the day-to-day health and long-term evolution of our internal Azure environment: Kubernetes workloads, data services, storage, networking, and identity systems. Maintain the bridge between cloud and lab, keeping our Linux hosts and hardware systems connected and operational as the platform grows.
  
Security and the External-Facing Cloud
  
Work closely with our network and cybersecurity teams to design and harden the external subscription before customers ever touch it. Zero-trust access, network segmentation, secrets management, private endpoints, and audit logging need to be built in from the start. We need someone who thinks about security architecturally, not just operationally.
  
Required Qualifications
  
Why Join Us
  
The work is technically rich and varied in a way that is hard to find. You will not be executing tickets. You will be shaping how the platform evolves, with real ownership and real impact on both the team that builds the product and the customers who use it. We are a collaborative group that values good judgment, welcomes new ideas, and tries hard to be a team people are glad to be part of.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

4+ years of hands-on experience with Azure DevOps and cloud infrastructure, including ownership of production environments.
  
Azure DevOps and CI/CD: Strong experience with YAML pipelines, Repos, Artifacts, self-hosted build agents, Git workflows, and release management, including deployment across development, test, and production environments, versioning, and rollback.
  
Kubernetes and AKS: Practical experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads using Docker and Helm, including configuration, networking, storage, scaling, and upgrades.
  
Azure infrastructure and networking: Experience managing compute, storage, virtual networks, DNS, firewalls, and connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments.
  
Infrastructure as Code: Experience creating repeatable infrastructure deployments using Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent tools.
  
Linux administration: Strong troubleshooting skills across services, processes, permissions, networking, storage, and shared file systems such as NFS.

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

**Job Purpose**

The Release Train Engineer is a servant leader and delivery coach for the Agile Release Train delivering GSK's network and connectivity platforms, applying SAFe practices within GSK's Technology operating model to coordinate the flow of value across the teams building and running those platforms. Operating consistently with the BCG platform operating model, the role treats the platform as a product delivered by a durable, cross-functional team, and is accountable for facilitating Programme Increment planning, coordinating dependencies and risks across teams, and driving predictable, high quality delivery through Agile ceremonies, flow metrics and continuous improvement.

* Support Product Management and Product Owners in refining the Programme Backlog and preparing content for Planning Interval events.

**Manage dependencies, risks and impediments across the train**

* Identify, track and resolve cross-team and cross-platform dependencies and risks using ROAM (Resolved, Owned, Accepted, Mitigated).
* Escalate and remove impediments to flow that individual teams cannot resolve themselves, including supplier, platform or portfolio level blockers.
* Coordinate with other Release Train Engineers, Solution Train Engineers and Platform Managers to sequence work across dependent platforms and domains.

**Drive flow, predictability and continuous improvement**

* Track and report flow metrics including velocity, programme predictability, cycle time and quality trends, and use them to drive improvement actions.
* Coach teams, Scrum Masters and Product Owners in Lean-Agile and SAFe practices, building local capability rather than acting as a single point of control.

The Senior Vice President (SVP) will support the execution of the Financial Crime Risk Management strategy for Citi's Banking business across the UK & EMEA region. This role is a critical component of the First Line of Defense (1LOD), providing cluster leadership and oversight of financial crime risk matters, while ensuring effective coordination across businesses, control functions, and legal entities.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior business stakeholders on financial crime risk matters, drive effective governance and portfolio oversight, lead strategic initiatives and thematic reviews, and support the continuous enhancement of Citi's financial crime risk management framework. **Job Requirements**  

As we grow ILM India, we are seeking a Talent Manager (Artist Manager) to be one of the first members of our team and be a key part of this exciting opportunity.  
  
The Talent Manager creates a positive and supportive environment for the artist and production teams by building meaningful relationships with the teams they manage, as well as the show leadership teams. They work closely with project leadership in order to schedule and manage crew with an overarching focus on the long-term growth of artists through performance feedback  
and career development, so our artists continue in the long term to grow and develop.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Create a collaborative and supportive environment for all artists to excel, with an open-door policy to encourage positive communication between you and the artists you manage
* Work closely with show leadership to ensure projects have the right teams assigned, considering both the project needs and the career development of the artists
* Assess any capacity and utilization challenges across your artist and production teams and proactively problem solve any issues, keeping all the relevant information up to date and accurate within our resource planning systems
* Evaluate and learn individual artist strengths; helping to develop cross utilization of teams to promote an effective workflow
* Work with supervisors, production, training and other talent managers to develop training plans for upcoming show needs and ongoing departmental talent development
* Create a positive and constructive feedback environment for your artists with the goal of helping artists grow and meet their long-term career goals, as well as continuing to improve their performance
* Manage your team's yearly merit increases
* Working with the talent coordinators, managing time off requests and other ad-hoc administration duties
* Identify recruitment requirements for your teams, partnering with recruiters in finding and hiring the best talent, with a continued focus on creating a diverse team
* Manage locally, but think globally - working collaboratively with all ILM studios to maximize crew utilization

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8-10 years of experience
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
* Genuine passion for management and ability to create an environment conducive for all team members to excel
* Ability to provide both positive and constructive feedback
* Scheduling and problem solving skills are proven, and VFX knowledge is sound
* Roll the sleeves up attitude, happy to take on a variety of responsibilities all contributing to the end goal of a positive team environment
* People feel comfortable talking to you and discussing their challenges and their successes
* Lead by example
* Instinct for creating teams, an eye for spotting talent and a passion for diversity and team culture.
